title: Ultrasonic Robot Car Control System
shortDescription: Distance-based speed control and obstacle avoidance.
fullDescription: A robot car control project that uses ultrasonic distance readings for speed control and obstacle avoidance.
studentLearning: How to read distance using ultrasonic sensors

learningOutcomes: Using distance readings for speed control
features: Distance-Based Speed Control: When the path ahead is clear, the robot car increases its speed based on the ultrasonic sensor reading.
Obstacle Avoidance: When the HC-SR04 detects an obstacle ahead, the robot car changes direction and continues along another path.
